_readme: Add clubs here to populate the hall hire section. Set available:true and fill in the fields. Clubs NOT in this file show the 'not yet listed' CTA.

bath-rugby.description: Bath Rugby's Recreation Ground offers premium event space in one of England's most iconic sporting venues, available for corporate hospitality, private functions and community events.
bath-rugby.booking_note: Contact the hospitality team to discuss your event requirements and check availability.
bath-rugby.notes: Bespoke packages available for weddings, corporate events and private parties. Minimum numbers may apply.

bristol-bears.description: Ashton Gate Stadium — home of Bristol Bears — offers world-class event and conference facilities for events of all sizes.
bristol-bears.booking_note: Multiple suites available to suit your event size and budget.
features: Multiple suite options from boardroom to gala

harlequins.description: The Twickenham Stoop offers prestigious event space in South West London, popular for corporate hospitality, awards evenings and private celebrations.
harlequins.booking_note: Contact our events team to discuss bespoke packages including matchday hospitality.

exeter-chiefs.description: Sandy Park — the home of Exeter Chiefs — is one of the South West's premier event venues, available for conferences, weddings, exhibitions and more.
exeter-chiefs.size: Sandy Park Suite and Westpoint Rooms
exeter-chiefs.booking_note: Our dedicated events team will work with you to create the perfect occasion.
features: LED lighting rig and AV support

leicester-tigers.description: Mattioli Woods Welford Road has hosted events for over 130 years and offers versatile hospitality and conference facilities in the heart of Leicester.
leicester-tigers.booking_note: Available for corporate events, private parties, exhibitions and charity fundraisers.

northampton-saints.description: cinch Stadium at Franklin's Gardens offers exceptional event space in Northampton, with flexible suites for every type of occasion.
northampton-saints.booking_note: Packages available for conferences, dinners, awards evenings and private parties.
